text.autoconfig.dragthings.title: Drag Things Settings
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.lerpSp: How quickly the item moves toward your cursor. Lower = smoother but slower. (5-50)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.dragFo: Spring force pulling the item toward the target position. (1-20)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.fricti: Air resistance while dragging. Higher = less overshoot and jitter. (70-99)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.throwM: How hard the item is thrown when you release it. (1-20)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.dragDi: How far in front of you the item floats while dragging. (1-10 blocks)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.pickup: How far away you can grab an item. (1-10 blocks)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.scroll: While dragging, scroll up/down to change how far the item floats in front of you. Range: 1-12 blocks. Resets on each grab.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.bobbin: Subtle up-down bobbing while dragging. 0 = off. (0-10)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.emissi: Dragged and hovered items glow at full brightness.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.showTo: Show item name and enchantments when looking at a ground item.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.raiseA: Slightly raise your arm while dragging an item.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.enable: Show sparkle trail and burst effects when grabbing, dragging, and releasing items.
Play sounds when grabbing, dragging, throwing, and when the item hits a block.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.gravit: Item falls naturally when released without throwing. Disable to make items float in place.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.showOu: Show a thin wireframe outline around the item while dragging.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.outlin:
Glow outline color as RGB hex. Default: 0x55FFFF (aqua).
Examples: 16777215 = white, 16711680 = red, 65535 = cyan.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.itemSc: Visual size of the dragged item. 100 = normal, 150 = 1.5x larger. Does not affect hitbox.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.maxDra: How many items to drag at once. The closest item leads, others follow in a chain.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.weight: When enabled, heavier items are harder to drag.
How much item type affects drag speed. 0 = no effect, 10 = full effect.
How much item count affects weight. 0 = ignore count, 10 = full effect.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.ritual: Drag an Enchanting Table near Lapis, an enchantable item, and XP orbs to enchant it.
How close (in blocks) lapis, the target item, and XP orbs need to be to the table.
How long everything must stay together before the enchant triggers.
How much XP orb value is needed for each enchant level. Lower = easier to reach high levels.
Hard cap on the enchant level the ritual can produce.
How much Lapis Lazuli is consumed per successful ritual.
Drag a Smithing Table near a template, base item, and addition to upgrade it without placing the block.
How close (in blocks) the template, base item, and addition need to be to the table.
Minimum ticks between successive smithing operations. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Drag a Grindstone over an enchanted item to strip its enchantments and recover XP orbs.
How close (in blocks) the enchanted item needs to be to the grindstone.
Minimum ticks between successive grindstone operations. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Drag a Furnace, Blast Furnace, or Smoker near fuel and an ingredient to smelt it over time.
How close (in blocks) fuel and ingredients need to be to the furnace.
How often the furnace looks for nearby fuel when cold. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Drag an Anvil near two items and XP orbs to repair or combine enchantments without placing the block.
How close (in blocks) items need to be to the anvil.
Minimum ticks between successive anvil operations. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Raw XP value consumed per enchantment level gained or repair step. Vanilla equivalent: ~7 XP = 1 level at low levels.
Drag a Crafting Table near the right items to craft any shapeless recipe without placing the block. Shaped recipes (grid layout) are not supported.
How close (in blocks) the ingredients need to be to the crafting table.
Minimum ticks between successive crafting operations. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Drag a Chest near dropped items to automatically vacuum them into its inventory. Works on regular and trapped chests.
How close (in blocks) dropped items need to be to get sucked into the chest.
Ticks between loot attempts. Lower = faster vacuum. 1 = every tick, 20 = once per second.
Show a rope/chain ribbon connecting your hand to the dragged item and any followers.
Visual width of the chain ribbon. 3 = very thin, 20 = thick. Default 6.
Opacity of the chain. The far end always fades slightly. (10-100)
Chain colour as an RGB hex integer. Default: 0xC8AA6E (warm rope tone).
How much the chain droops between anchor points. 0 = straight line, 40 = very saggy. Default 12.
How quickly the chain fades in when dragging starts and fades out after release. (1-30)
Show a smooth geometry trail behind dragged items.
Number of position samples kept per item. More = longer and smoother trail. (8-48)
Opacity of the trail head. The tail always fades to fully transparent. (10-100)

Trail colour as an RGB hex integer. Default: 0x8ADCFF (sky blue).
Examples: 16777215 = white, 16711680 = red, 65535 = cyan, 16744448 = orange.
How quickly the trail fades in when dragging starts and fades out after release. Higher = snappier. (1-30)
Visual width of the trail ribbon. 5 = very thin, 40 = thick. Default 12.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.enable: When enabled: releasing a BlockItem while looking at a block face and moving slowly places the block instead of throwing it. Disable if it triggers accidentally.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.feel.e: Smoothly ramp the spring up to full strength right after grabbing, instead of full force on the very first tick.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.feel.s: How long the "settling in" ramp takes after grabbing an item. (0-1000 ms)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.feel.d: How quickly scrolling to change drag distance eases toward the new target. Higher = snappier. (1-100)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.feel.a: Bobbing amplitude shrinks the faster the item moves, instead of staying constant.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.feel.b: How aggressively speed reduces bobbing. Higher = bobbing disappears sooner as you move. (0-20)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.feel.e: Items elongate along their direction of travel and briefly flatten on impact.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.feel.s: Overall strength of the squash & stretch effect. 100 = default, 0 = off, 200 = exaggerated.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.feel.f: How quickly a follower that fell behind eases back into place. Higher = snappier catch-up hop. (10-90)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.feel.e: A small FOV "punch-in" plays when a dragged item slams into something. Never affects aim/look direction.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.feel.c: Strength of the impact FOV kick. 100 = default, 0 = off, 200 = dramatic.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.mobDra: Master switch for the whole mob-drag feature.
Peaceful animals: cows, sheep, pigs, chickens, villagers...
Mobs that fight back if provoked: wolves, bees, iron golems, endermen...
Mobs that attack on sight: zombies, skeletons, creepers, spiders...
Ender Dragon, Wither. Off by default for obvious reasons.
Comma-separated entity IDs to ALWAYS allow, e.g. minecraft:enderman,minecraft:witch
Comma-separated entity IDs to ALWAYS block, e.g. minecraft:villager,minecraft:iron_golem
The mob can't take or deal damage while being carried.
How long the shrink-down animation takes when you grab a mob.
How long the grow-back animation takes when you let go.
How small the mob shrinks to, as a percentage of its normal size.
Maximum range to hover/grab a mob from.
Once fully shrunk, show the mob's spawn egg icon instead of a tiny 3D model (falls back to the 3D model if no spawn egg exists for that mob).
